description: Mounted on a pylon in the museum air park. Renumbered 100472 in 1970; flew with 414 (EW) Squadron at CFB North Bay and made its last flight North Bay to Bagotville on 10 November 1981. Wears false serial 18437 coded KE on the port side and 18741 coded DL to starboard.
museum_name: Musée de la Défense aérienne de Bagotville

description: Ex-German Air Force Sabre 6 that stood at the main gate of CFB Lahr in 444 Squadron colours, came to Bagotville in 1994 and was unveiled in the park on 8 June 1996 repainted silver as 19454 coded AO of 414 Squadron. Canadian Warplanes also gives its identity as 23605, which is the serial worn by the Winnipeg Sabre; the true construction identity is unresolved and no serial is recorded here.
museum_name: Musée de la Défense aérienne de Bagotville
